decisions.reason: As a flagship adapter tightly linked to the firm’s core track-system business, it likely clears satisficing aspirations or is protected by strategic commitment and complementarity with existing sales.
A close-to-core LED luminaire line fits the firm’s established capabilities and broad premium assortment, so unless results are clearly below aspiration it is more likely to be retained.

The home automation server box is the most support-intensive and potentially outside the firm’s strongest lighting core, so if its performance is only ambiguous management would likely reallocate resources after several years.
A luminaire family with several models strengthens the premium portfolio and uses existing design, engineering, and channel resources, making retention the more likely satisficing choice.
